lessons.name: On the Road
lessons.description: Tell the story of a road trip, with the imperfect for background and the aorist for events.

multiple_choice.name: Match the road trip words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: While we were travelling
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Докато __ към морето, слушахме музика.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Докато пътувахме към морето, слушахме музика." means "While we were driving to the sea, we listened to music." Both actions are background, so both take the imperfect.

true_false.name: True or false: Imperfect background
true_false.sentence: The imperfect ("пътувахме", "говореше") often describes the background of a story.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The aorist then moves the story forward: "...и изведнъж колата спря."

fill_in_the_blank.name: We stopped for lunch
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: По пътя __ в едно малко село за обяд.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "По пътя спряхме в едно малко село за обяд." means "On the way we stopped in a small village for lunch." A single event takes the aorist.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Every summer he packed the car
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Всяко лято баща ми __ колата и тръгвахме за Гърция.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Всяко лято баща ми товареше колата и тръгвахме за Гърция." means "Every summer my father would pack the car and we would set off for Greece." A repeated past action takes the imperfect.

true_false.name: True or false: Benzinostantsiya
true_false.sentence: "Бензиностанция" is a bus station.
true_false.explanation: A бензиностанция is a petrol station. A bus station is an "автогара".

multiple_choice.name: Match the driving verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: When we arrived
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Когато __ в Пловдив, вече беше тъмно.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Когато пристигнахме в Пловдив, вече беше тъмно." means "When we arrived in Plovdiv, it was already dark." The arrival is an event; the darkness is the background.

true_false.name: True or false: Zarezhdam
true_false.sentence: At a petrol station, "зареждам" means filling up the tank.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Зареждам с бензин" is "I fill up with petrol".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The road was narrow
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Пътят __ тесен и много стръмен.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Пътят беше тесен и много стръмен." means "The road was narrow and very steep."

lessons.name: Driving in Bulgaria
lessons.description: Road signs, fines, vignettes and the parts of a car.

multiple_choice.name: Match the road rules
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: An electronic vignette
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: За магистралите ви трябва електронна __ за колата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За магистралите ви трябва електронна винетка за колата." means "You need an electronic vignette for your car to use the motorways."

true_false.name: True or false: Right-hand side
true_false.sentence: In Bulgaria, cars drive on the right-hand side of the road.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Overtaking is on the left.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The officer gave me a fine
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Полицаят ми __ глоба за превишена скорост.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Полицаят ми даде глоба за превишена скорост." means "The police officer gave me a speeding fine."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Parking is allowed
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Паркирането в центъра е __ само с платен билет.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Паркирането в центъра е позволено само с платен билет." means "Parking in the centre is allowed only with a paid ticket." Паркирането is neuter.

true_false.name: True or false: Globa
true_false.sentence: A "глоба" is a kind of road sign.
true_false.explanation: A глоба is a fine.

multiple_choice.name: Match the car parts
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Four winter tyres
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Колата има четири __ за зима.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Колата има четири гуми за зима." means "The car has four winter tyres."

true_false.name: True or false: Volan
true_false.sentence: "Волан" is a steering wheel.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The driver sits "зад волана", behind the wheel.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If you had driven slower
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ по-бавно, нямаше да получиш глоба.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако караше по-бавно, нямаше да получиш глоба." means "If you had driven more slowly, you would not have got a fine."

lessons.name: Camping and Nature
lessons.description: Tents, campfires and springs, and a weekend in the wild.

multiple_choice.name: Match the camping words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We pitched our tent
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Опънахме __ си до реката.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Опънахме палатката си до реката." means "We pitched our tent by the river."

true_false.name: True or false: Izvor
true_false.sentence: "Извор" is a natural spring of water.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Many Bulgarian villages have a fountain fed by one, a "чешма".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Around the fire
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вечерта седяхме около __ и пеехме.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вечерта седяхме около огъня и пеехме." means "In the evening we sat around the fire and sang."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Ice-cold water
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Водата в __ беше ледено студена.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Водата в извора беше ледено студена." means "The water in the spring was ice cold."

true_false.name: True or false: Vodopad
true_false.sentence: "Водопад" means "lake".
true_false.explanation: A водопад is a waterfall, literally "water fall". A lake is an "езеро".

multiple_choice.name: Match the outdoor phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The children picked mushrooms
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Децата __ много гъби в гората.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата набраха много гъби в гората." means "The children picked lots of mushrooms in the forest."

true_false.name: True or false: National parks
true_false.sentence: Rila and Pirin are national parks in Bulgaria.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Pirin National Park is also on the UNESCO World Heritage list.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We put out the fire
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Преди да тръгнем, __ огъня.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Преди да тръгнем, загасихме огъня." means "Before we left, we put out the fire."

lessons.name: Healthy Body, Healthy Mind
lessons.description: Stress, sport and balance, with the negative pronouns никой, нищо and никакъв.

multiple_choice.name: Match the wellbeing words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Sport helps
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Спортът __ да се справим със стреса.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Спортът помага да се справим със стреса." means "Sport helps us cope with stress."

true_false.name: True or false: V zdravo tyalo
true_false.sentence: "В здраво тяло – здрав дух" means "A healthy mind in a healthy body".
true_false.explanation: Correct. It comes from the Latin "mens sana in corpore sano".

fill_in_the_blank.name: As a child I played every day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Като малък всеки ден __ по два часа футбол.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Като малък всеки ден играех по два часа футбол." means "As a child I played football for two hours every day." A past habit takes the imperfect.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Nobody told me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ не ми каза, че състезанието е отменено.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Никой не ми каза, че състезанието е отменено." means "Nobody told me the race had been cancelled."

true_false.name: True or false: Nishto
true_false.sentence: "Нищо" means "nobody".
true_false.explanation: "Нищо" means "nothing". "Nobody" is "никой".

multiple_choice.name: Match the negative words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I know nobody here
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не познавам __ в този град.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не познавам никого в този град." means "I do not know anybody in this town." As an object, никой becomes никого.

true_false.name: True or false: Double negative
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian uses double negatives: "Никой не дойде."
true_false.explanation: Correct. The sentence means "Nobody came".

fill_in_the_blank.name: I need no help at all
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не ми трябва __ помощ.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не ми трябва никаква помощ." means "I do not need any help at all." Помощ is feminine.

lessons.name: What People Say
lessons.description: Pass on stories and rumours with the renarrative mood.

multiple_choice.name: Match seen and heard
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English description to the Bulgarian verb form.

fill_in_the_blank.name: There was once a town
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Според легендата едно време тук __ голям град, но той изчезнал.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Според легендата едно време тук имало голям град, но той изчезнал." means "According to legend, there was once a big town here, but it disappeared." A legend is told in the renarrative throughout.

true_false.name: True or false: Renarrative forms
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian verbs have special forms, such as "бил" and "отишъл", for things you did not see yourself.
true_false.explanation: Correct. They are called the renarrative mood (преизказно наклонение).

fill_in_the_blank.name: Her son went to Germany
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Съседката ми разказа, че синът ѝ __ в Германия и там се оженил.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...синът ѝ заминал в Германия и там се оженил" means "...her son went to Germany and got married there." The story is passed on, so it stays renarrative, like оженил.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A poor but clever man
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имало едно време един бедняк, който __ много хитър.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имало едно време един бедняк, който бил много хитър." means "Once upon a time there was a poor man who was very clever."

true_false.name: True or false: Otishal
true_false.sentence: The form "отишъл" means you saw him leave with your own eyes.
true_false.explanation: "Отишъл" reports what you heard. If you saw it yourself, you say "отиде".

multiple_choice.name: Match the rumour words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: According to rumours
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ слуховете, фирмата ще затвори.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Според слуховете, фирмата ще затвори." means "According to the rumours, the company will close."

true_false.name: True or false: Imalo edno vreme
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian fairy tales usually begin with "Имало едно време", a renarrative form.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It means "Once upon a time", literally "There was (they say) once a time".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The dragon ate a sheep
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Разправят, че змеят живеел в пещерата и __ по цяла овца на ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...змеят живеел в пещерата и изяждал по цяла овца на ден" means "...the dragon lived in the cave and ate a whole sheep a day." Both verbs stay renarrative.

lessons.name: Impressions of Bulgaria
lessons.description: What surprises visitors, and what it takes to feel at home.

multiple_choice.name: Match the impression words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Hospitable people
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Хората тук са много __ и винаги помагат.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хората тук са много гостоприемни и винаги помагат." means "People here are very hospitable and always help." Хората is plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Rose oil
true_false.sentence: Bulgaria is known for its rose oil, produced in the Rose Valley near Kazanlak.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian rose oil is used in perfumes around the world.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Nature impressed me most
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Най-много ме __ природата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Най-много ме впечатли природата." means "What impressed me most was the nature." Природата is the singular subject.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I would like to live in Plovdiv
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако имах възможност, __ да живея в Пловдив.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако имах възможност, бих искал да живея в Пловдив." means "If I had the chance, I would like to live in Plovdiv."

true_false.name: True or false: Head shaking
true_false.sentence: In Bulgaria, shaking your head from side to side always means "no".
true_false.explanation: Traditionally, a side-to-side shake means "yes" and a nod means "no", which confuses many visitors.

multiple_choice.name: Match the settling-in words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Getting used to Cyrillic
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Трудно ми беше да __ с кирилицата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трудно ми беше да свикна с кирилицата." means "It was hard for me to get used to Cyrillic."

true_false.name: True or false: Rose Festival
true_false.sentence: The Rose Festival in Kazanlak takes place in early summer.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is held at the start of June, when the roses are picked.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I have lived in Sofia for two years
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вече __ две години в София и се чувствам у дома.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вече живея две години в София и се чувствам у дома." means "I have been living in Sofia for two years and feel at home." Bulgarian uses the present for something still going on.

lessons.name: Neighbours and Community
lessons.description: Life in a block of flats, house meetings and getting along.

multiple_choice.name: Match the block words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Our neighbours
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Съседите __ организираха парти в двора.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Съседите ни организираха парти в двора." means "Our neighbours organised a party in the yard."

true_false.name: True or false: Domoupravitel
true_false.sentence: In a Bulgarian block of flats, the "домоуправител" looks after the building.
true_false.explanation: Correct. They collect money for repairs and call the house meetings.

fill_in_the_blank.name: She brought me a cake
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Съседката от третия етаж ми __ торта за рождения ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Съседката от третия етаж ми донесе торта за рождения ден." means "The neighbour from the third floor brought me a birthday cake."

fill_in_the_blank.name: The meeting will be held
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Събранието на входа ще се __ в четвъртък.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Събранието на входа ще се проведе в четвъртък." means "The residents' meeting will be held on Thursday."

true_false.name: True or false: Stalbishte
true_false.sentence: A "стълбище" is a garden.
true_false.explanation: A стълбище is a staircase.

multiple_choice.name: Match the community verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I get on with my neighbours
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Разбирам се много добре __ съседите си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Разбирам се много добре със съседите си." means "I get on very well with my neighbours." Before с or з, the preposition с becomes със.

true_false.name: True or false: Sharing preserves
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian neighbours often share home-made food such as lyutenitsa or jam.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Autumn preserving is a social event in many neighbourhoods.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Our neighbour complained
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Съседът ни се __ от шума вчера.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Съседът ни се оплака от шума вчера." means "Our neighbour complained about the noise yesterday."

multiple_choice.name: Match the renovation words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We renovated the bathroom
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Миналото лято __ ремонт на банята.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналото лято направихме ремонт на банята." means "Last summer we renovated the bathroom."

true_false.name: True or false: Remont
true_false.sentence: "Ремонт" means repair or renovation work.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "В ремонт" on a sign means "under repair".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Painted light blue
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Стените бяха __ в светлосиньо.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Стените бяха боядисани в светлосиньо." means "The walls were painted light blue."

fill_in_the_blank.name: While the builders worked
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Докато майсторите __ по банята, ние живеехме при родителите си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Докато майсторите работеха по банята, ние живеехме при родителите си." means "While the builders were working on the bathroom, we stayed with my parents." Both actions are background.

true_false.name: True or false: Maystor
true_false.sentence: A "майстор" can only be a master artist, never a builder.
true_false.explanation: A майстор is also any skilled tradesman, such as a builder or a plumber.

multiple_choice.name: Match the tools
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A hammer and a nail
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Трябва ми __ и пирон, за да закача картината.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трябва ми чук и пирон, за да закача картината." means "I need a hammer and a nail to hang the picture."

true_false.name: True or false: Stalba
true_false.sentence: "Стълба" is a ladder, and "стълбище" is a staircase.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The two words share the same root.

fill_in_the_blank.name: It would have finished sooner
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако бяхме наели майстор, ремонтът __ по-бързо.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако бяхме наели майстор, ремонтът щеше да свърши по-бързо." means "If we had hired a builder, the renovation would have finished sooner."

lessons.name: Protecting the Environment
lessons.description: Recycling, clean air and small everyday changes.

multiple_choice.name: Match the environment words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The yellow bin
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Хвърлям пластмасата в __ контейнер.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хвърлям пластмасата в жълтия контейнер." means "I throw plastic into the yellow bin."

true_false.name: True or false: Green bins
true_false.sentence: In many Bulgarian towns, glass is collected in green containers.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Paper usually goes in blue and plastic in yellow.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If everyone sorted their waste
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако всички __ отпадъците си, градът щеше да е по-чист.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако всички разделяха отпадъците си, градът щеше да е по-чист." means "If everyone sorted their waste, the town would be cleaner."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A serious problem in winter
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Замърсяването на въздуха __ сериозен проблем през зимата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Замърсяването на въздуха е сериозен проблем през зимата." means "Air pollution is a serious problem in winter."

true_false.name: True or false: Otpadatsi
true_false.sentence: "Отпадъци" means fresh food.
true_false.explanation: "Отпадъци" means waste or rubbish.

multiple_choice.name: Match the green verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Switch off the light
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Изключвай __ в стаята, когато излизаш.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изключвай лампата в стаята, когато излизаш." means "Switch off the light in the room when you go out."

true_false.name: True or false: Plastic bags
true_false.sentence: Plastic bags in Bulgarian shops usually cost money.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The charge is there to cut plastic waste.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We planted a hundred trees
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Миналата пролет __ сто дървета в парка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналата пролет засадихме сто дървета в парка." means "Last spring we planted a hundred trees in the park."

lessons.name: Plans and Dreams
lessons.description: Hopes, goals and what you would do if you could.

multiple_choice.name: Match the dream words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My own restaurant
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Мечтата ми е да __ собствен ресторант.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мечтата ми е да отворя собствен ресторант." means "My dream is to open my own restaurant."

true_false.name: True or false: Dano
true_false.sentence: "Дано" expresses a hope: "Дано успея!"
true_false.explanation: Correct. The sentence means "I hope I succeed!"

fill_in_the_blank.name: If I win the lottery
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако спечеля от лотарията, __ около света.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако спечеля от лотарията, ще пътувам около света." means "If I win the lottery, I will travel around the world." A real condition takes the future.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I would have changed jobs
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако бях по-смел, отдавна __ работата си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако бях по-смел, отдавна щях да сменя работата си." means "If I were braver, I would have changed jobs long ago."

true_false.name: True or false: Mechta
true_false.sentence: "Мечта" means "a nightmare".
true_false.explanation: A мечта is a dream or a wish. A nightmare is a "кошмар".

multiple_choice.name: Match the future words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I plan to learn Spanish
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Догодина __ да уча испански.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Догодина смятам да уча испански." means "Next year I plan to learn Spanish." Смятам да means "I intend to".

true_false.name: True or false: Dogodina
true_false.sentence: "Догодина" means "next year".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Last year" is "миналата година".

fill_in_the_blank.name: One day I would like to go
